Home / Our Quality Standards

Quality checked before anything is issued.

How ENGISOFT checks people and deliverables: technical assessment before placement, model QA before every issue and a central support layer behind deployed teams.

Quality framework

Two things to get right.

Quality in BIM staffing and BIM delivery comes down to two questions: is the person able to do the work, and is the model right before it leaves the team?

ENGISOFT answers the first with technical assessment before anyone is shortlisted, and the second with checklists agreed from your BEP and applied before every issue. We do not claim certifications that have not been independently verified.

  • Verified Talent→
  • Technical Assurance→

People

How professionals are verified.

01

Experience verification

Employment history and project exposure reviewed against what the candidate claims.

02

Software assessment

Proficiency tested in the tools the role needs: Revit, Navisworks, ACC, Civil 3D and others.

03

Technical interview

Discipline-specific questions with an engineer, covering standards, LOD and coordination judgement.

04

Practical BIM test

A time-boxed exercise reproducing a realistic modelling or coordination task.

05

Portfolio verification

Work samples reviewed where the candidate and former employers authorise it.

06

Communication & standards

English communication and knowledge of BIM execution and information standards.

Deliverables

How models are checked.

01

Checklist from your BEP

Naming, LOD, parameters, coordinates and drawing standards turned into a checklist before work starts.

02

Self-check

The modeler checks their own work against the checklist before handing over.

03

Peer or lead review

A coordinator or BIM lead reviews model health, standards and open clashes.

04

Issue with a record

Models are issued with a record of what was checked and any open items.

Support

When something goes wrong.

01

Issue raised

The deployed engineer or project lead logs a technical issue with model, view and context.

02

Triaged

A central engineer classifies severity and assigns the right specialist.

03

Reviewed

The specialist reviews the model or workflow and proposes a resolution.

04

Resolved

Guidance is applied and verified against the project standards.

05

Documented

The issue and resolution are recorded to feed checklists and the knowledge base.
